title: A Bird in the Apple Tree

paragraphs.text: We have a small apple farm. There are many apple trees. The trees are tall and green.
paragraphs.translation: 我们有一个小小的苹果园。那里有很多苹果树，树又高又绿。

paragraphs.text: Look at the little bird. It sits in the apple tree. The bird is brown and small. It can sing nice songs.
paragraphs.translation: 看那只小鸟。它待在苹果树上。这只鸟是棕色的，个子小小，还会唱好听的歌。

paragraphs.text: My dog runs to the tree. His name is Lucky. Lucky is white and black. He can run very fast.
paragraphs.translation: 我的狗跑到树边。它叫 Lucky。Lucky 是黑白相间的，跑得特别快。

paragraphs.text: The bird likes red apples. It sits on a big apple. Lucky looks at the bird.
paragraphs.translation: 这只鸟喜欢红苹果，它坐在一个大苹果上。Lucky 就盯着它看。

paragraphs.text: I have six red apples. My sister has two green apples. We are happy in the orchard.
paragraphs.translation: 我摘了六个红苹果，妹妹有两个青苹果。我们在果园里可开心了。

paragraphs.text: Mom makes apple juice for us. The juice is sweet and cold. We love our apple farm.
paragraphs.translation: 妈妈给我们做苹果汁，果汁又甜又凉。我们都很爱我们的苹果园。
